::: {.callout-note}
### Research Philosophy: Curated Signal, Zero Clutter
This registry is machine-readable and human-navigable. It records verified mathematical invariants, empirical effect sizes, and crucially, **rejected hypotheses**. Recording what *failed* prevents future research cycles and autonomous AI agents from repeating dead ends.
:::

## 1. Predictive Architecture Tiers

Every experiment maps directly to one of the five tiers in the `mlbr` hierarchical forecasting stack:

| Tier | Name | Target Outcome | Primary Models |
|:---:|:---|:---|:---|
| **Level 1** | **Pitch Physics & Quality** | $\Pr(\text{Whiff} \mid \text{Swing})$, Run Value / 100 | XGBoost, Random Forest, GAM |
| **Level 2** | **Player Projections** | True Talent Rates (wOBA, K%, BB%) | PECOTA Comps, ZiPS Aging Curves, Marcel |
| **Level 3** | **Team BaseRuns** | Expected Runs Scored & Allowed | BaseRuns Equation, Pythagenpat Exponents |
| **Level 4** | **Game Simulation** | Win Probability $\Pr(\text{Home Win})$ | Monte Carlo Markov Chain (10k rollouts) |
| **Level 5** | **Betting Markets** | Market Edge & Expected Value | Fractional Kelly Staking (Polymarket / Kalshi) |

---

## 2. Status Definitions

* <span class="badge bg-success" style="color:white; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:4px;">VALIDATED</span>: Tested on historical data ($\le 2023$) and confirmed out-of-time ($2024–2026$). Active in production feature views.
* <span class="badge bg-warning text-dark" style="padding:4px 8px; border-radius:4px;">IN_PROGRESS</span>: In active exploratory data analysis or hyperparameter tuning.
* <span class="badge bg-danger" style="color:white; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:4px;">REJECTED</span>: Hypothesis tested and proven non-predictive or redundant (signals dead ends).
* <span class="badge bg-secondary" style="color:white; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:4px;">DEPRECATED</span>: Previously validated model superseded by a superior architecture.

## 3. Active Experiment Ledger

```{r}
#| label: load-registry
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  .libPaths(c("/mnt/storage/R/library", .libPaths()))
  library(jsonlite)
  library(dplyr)
  library(knitr)
})

reg_path <- "/mnt/storage/Rprojects/mlbr/experiments/registry.json"
experiments <- if (file.exists(reg_path)) {
  jsonlite::fromJSON(reg_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
} else {
  list()
}
```

```{r}
#| label: render-experiments
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

if (length(experiments) == 0) {
  cat("*No experiments registered yet.*")
} else {
  for (exp in experiments) {
    status_color <- switch(
      exp$status,
      "VALIDATED" = "success",
      "IN_PROGRESS" = "warning text-dark",
      "REJECTED" = "danger",
      "secondary"
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("### %s: %s\n\n", exp$id, exp$title))
    cat(sprintf("**Tier:** %s | **Status:** <span class='badge bg-%s' style='padding:3px 6px; border-radius:3px;'>%s</span> | **Updated:** `%s`\n\n",
                exp$tier_name, status_color, exp$status, substr(exp$updated_at, 1, 10)))
    
    cat(sprintf("> %s\n\n", exp$summary))
    
    # Formulas table
    if (length(exp$formulas) > 0) {
      cat("#### Verified Formulas\n")
      cat("```\n")
      for (fname in names(exp$formulas)) {
        cat(sprintf("%s: %s\n", fname, exp$formulas[[fname]]))
      }
      cat("```\n\n")
    }
    
    # Key Metrics
    if (length(exp$metrics) > 0) {
      cat("#### Empirical Validation Metrics\n")
      cat("| Metric | Value |\n|:---|:---|\n")
      for (mname in names(exp$metrics)) {
        val <- exp$metrics[[mname]]
        if (is.numeric(val)) {
          val_str <- if (val >= 1000) format(val, big.mark = ",") else as.character(val)
        } else {
          val_str <- as.character(val)
        }
        cat(sprintf("| `%s` | **%s** |\n", mname, val_str))
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
    
    # Artifacts & Links
    if (length(exp$artifacts) > 0) {
      cat("#### Artifacts & Research Links\n")
      for (aname in names(exp$artifacts)) {
        target <- exp$artifacts[[aname]]
        if (grepl("^http", target)) {
          cat(sprintf("- **%s**: [%s](%s)\n", aname, target, target))
        } else {
          cat(sprintf("- **%s**: `%s`\n", aname, target))
        }
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
    cat("---\n\n")
  }
}
```

## 4. How to Register an Experiment

To log an experiment from an R script or console:

```r
library(mlbr)

mlbr::lake_log_experiment(
  id         = "EXP-002-FASTBALL-DELTAS",
  title      = "Fastball-Relative Velocity Delta (ΔV) and Offspeed Deception",
  tier       = 1,
  status     = "IN_PROGRESS",
  summary    = "Evaluates offspeed swing-and-miss lift conditioned on velocity separation from primary fastball.",
  hypotheses = c("Changeups with ΔV > 10 mph generate +25% higher whiff rates than changeups with ΔV < 6 mph."),
  features   = c("delta_v", "delta_ivb", "delta_hb")
)
```

The function automatically updates:
1. `experiments/registry.json` (Machine-readable database)
2. `experiments/README.md` (Human-readable table)
3. `data/manifest/agent_context.json` (AI agent context)
